task.brief: Investigate the dependencies of https://github.com/example/vuln-shop for known vulnerabilities: prove reachability, assess upgrade impact, validate the fix, and write a security investigation report.

text: Decomposing the brief into a subtask DAG.

subtasks.title: List repository dependencies
subtasks.description: Fetch the vuln-shop source and list every dependency from package.json and lockfiles with resolved versions. Accept when the inventory names qs 6.5.2 and unused-vuln-lib 1.0.0 with evidence.

subtasks.title: Research vulnerabilities
subtasks.description: Query OSV and the npm registry for each inventoried dependency; record advisories, severity, affected symbols and patched versions from two independent sources. Accept when every dependency has a sourced verdict.

subtasks.title: Assess reachability
subtasks.description: For each researched vulnerability, prove exists vs exposed vs exploitable from the import graph, call sites of affected symbols, entrypoints, routes and tests. Accept when every vulnerability has a REACHABLE / NOT_REACHABLE / UNKNOWN verdict backed by a completed search.

subtasks.title: Assess upgrade impact
subtasks.description: For each candidate upgrade, compare versions, read release notes and changelogs, and check removed APIs against repository usage. Accept when every upgrade has a LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH level with risks and unknowns, never a percentage.

subtasks.title: Synthesize security findings
subtasks.description: Reconcile inventory, research, reachability and impact into one finding per vulnerability with a recommended action and candidate remediations for the sandbox. Accept when every finding follows the recommendation rules with blackboard-cited evidence.

subtasks.title: Validate remediations in sandbox
subtasks.description: Code-driven: simulate each candidate remediation from the investigator in the isolated sandbox and record PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN with test counts. No agent is routed to this subtask.

subtasks.title: Write investigation report
subtasks.description: Write the section-8 security investigation report: counts, per-finding reachability with evidence, upgrade and impact, sandbox validation, critic verdict and recommended action. Accept when every finding is covered and unknowns are listed, not hidden.
